listing.name: Wacki: Kosmiczna rozgrywka / Wacki port
listing.summary: A from-scratch C/SDL2 reimplementation of Wacki: Kosmiczna rozgrywka (1998), a cult Polish point-and-click adventure. Reverse-engineered opcode-by-opcode from the original. Plays start to finish on macOS, Linux, Windows, Android, Miyoo and PortMaster handhelds, and the PlayStation 2.
